name: print-social-purple-time-waits-quote-post-with-alarm-clock-render
title: Violet quote card 'Time waits for no one' with a violet 3D alarm clock rising from the bottom
whatItIs: A violet square with a small URL and logo, a white rounded card with three dots at the top and a quote 'Time waits for no one, but you have the power to make the most of it.' with a short underline, and a glossy violet alarm clock cropped at the bottom.
whatItMeans: Bold and simple; a clock render turns a quote into a visual reminder.
techniques: Put the quote on a white window-like card.
Use a monochrome 3D object matching the background.
Crop the object at the bottom.
